position_revisions.why: The frame holds: what the 1 October call settled on the diagnostic's sequencing and duration. The old member said the diagnostic runs two full weeks and starts with the warehouse team before management. Today's notes replace the duration: eight working days, because the warehouse team has only four shift leads to interview (src-1). They keep the sequencing, with the warehouse team still before management (src-2). Dropping the old member removes the two-week claim, and src-2 carries the unchanged sequencing half forward. This follows the earlier retention revision on the same position, where a later statement replaced a settled figure.
